title: Photos, videos and files in the timeline
summary: Timeline rows for images, videos, stickers and files: a blurred preview while loading, the media itself when it may show, the caption under it, and the upload progress of own media. A tap opens media-viewer or the file.

kind.description: From the message type. Voice and audio are voice-message rows.

sizeLabel.description: File size, already formatted by the system ("2,4 MB").

width.description: Pixels, for the row aspect ratio.

height.description: Pixels, for the row aspect ratio.

blurhash.description: The blurred placeholder from the event.

display.description: placeholder: blurhash only, before the thumbnail loads. tapToShow: the show-media setting hides it until a tap. loading: downloading. shown: the thumbnail or image shows. failed: the download failed.

uploadProgress.description: Own media while sending: percent 0 to 100.

description.description: image only: the sender's description from the m.image content field of registries/image-descriptions.json (bipe-chat/bipe#501): a string, trimmed, not blank, at most imageDescriptionMaxLength characters.

media.description: The row. Sender, time, reactions, reply quote and receipts come from timeline-rows MessageDetails.

showMedia.description: The setting bipe_chats_show_media: always, only in DMs and closed groups, or only on tap. Stored in the account (MSC4278, see notes).

fromStranger.description: true in a DM that the person accepted from chat-requests while the other person is not a contact (see notes): their images, videos and stickers show as tapToShow, whatever showMedia says.

appear.effect: Loads the thumbnail (or the image when it has none) through the media cache when display may show it.

tapToShow.effect: Shows media hidden by showMedia for this message.

open.effect: image, video, sticker: opens media-viewer. file: downloads the file to the cache and opens the system preview or share sheet.

cancelUpload.effect: Own media while sending: cancels the send and removes the row.

playAnimation.effect: Plays an animated sticker that waits for a tap (see notes).

notes: Encrypted media: the event's MediaSource holds the key; the SDK downloads and decrypts on the phone. Media never goes through a Bipe server other than the homeserver.
showMedia privateOnly: media shows in DMs and in groups that need an invite; in a public group it waits for a tap. The setting row lives in the Conversas e mídia group of settings.
The row keeps its size from width and height before the media loads, so the timeline does not jump. Without size: a 4:3 box.
bipe_app_media_image, _video, _file and _sticker are the accessibility labels, and the preview text in replies, the chat list and notifications (message-reply, notification-service).
Captions show under the media as text, and the scam warning reads the caption (scam-warning). A caption is edited with message-edit (EditedContent.MediaCaption).

Stickers show without a bubble, at most 160 points wide, animated when ImageInfo.isAnimated or the WebP has more than one frame (ADR 0205). Saving stickers is the stickers issue (bipe_action_save_sticker).
A photo that is a receipt image gets no special card here; the receipt scam check reads text only.
Delete and forward come from message-actions; media delete uses message-delete (bipe_dm_media_delete_body is the media library text, not this row).

Image descriptions (bipe-chat/bipe#501): the accessibility label of an image row is bipe_app_media_image_described with the description when it has one, else bipe_app_media_image; VoiceOver and TalkBack read it before the caption. The SDK message types have no field for it, so the app reads it from the event JSON (EventTimelineItemDebugInfo.originalJson, the decrypted event). A field on any other message type is ignored.

showMedia lives in the account, not only on the phone (bipe-chat/bipe#827): the standard account data m.media_preview_config of MSC4278, read and written through the SDK, so both phones of one person and other Matrix clients agree. always = MediaPreviews.on, privateOnly = private, never = off. The app keeps a copy on the phone for the rows and follows Client.subscribeToMediaPreviewConfig of the current account. An account without the setting keeps the phone's value (default always) and the app writes it once.

fromStranger (bipe-chat/bipe#827): a DM counts as accepted from chat-requests when the person accepted it in chat-request on this phone (the app remembers the room ID on the phone). The other person is a contact when the address book lookup of people found them (contacts). Without contacts access nobody is a contact, so the media waits. Own media always shows. A tap shows that one message only.

An animated sticker plays in a loop. It shows its first frame with a play mark (bipe_a11y_sticker_play) and waits for a tap (playAnimation) when the data saver is on and the phone is not on Wi-Fi (data-use), or with Reduce Motion (iOS) or animations off (Android).
